title: Comparison protocol should make fairness assumptions explicit
quote: Under this accounting, abstention is not a conservative compromise but the only correct default: on the confirmatory substrate the largest measured effect of acting anyway was negative (the best-single-confidence baseline loses 4.5 points where tact’s dead zone holds it exactly at the sc floor).
explanation: Comparative evaluation language was detected. Deep review should verify that baseline tuning, data splits, and reporting conventions are described symmetrically.
